Field.Name: Scene name
Field.WallStyleHint: Straight: rooms and corridors with flat walls; each hex belongs to the side its center is on. Only matters on hex grids.
Field.MapSizeHint: In grid hexes/squares (in GURPS, 1 hex = 1 yard).
Field.TeleportRoomsHint: Rooms with no access on foot. Only reachable through a teleport circle (both ways).
Field.TeleportConfirmHint: Shows a confirmation when stepping on the circle instead of teleporting right away.
Field.PresetHint: Fills in map and room sizes at once.
Field.RoomSizeHint: Smallest and largest side of a room, in hexes.
Field.ExtraLoopsHint: Extra links between rooms, for alternate paths.
Field.CellSizeHint: Image resolution. 100 works for almost everything; raise it only for heavy zoom.
Field.LightPlacementHint: On the walls: 1 to 4 torches per room depending on size, away from doors.
Field.SecretRoomsHint: Linked by a narrow passage ending in a Foundry secret door. Players see a wall until the GM reveals the door.
Field.ScenesHint: More than 1: creates several scenes in a folder, side by side (4 = 2×2). Corridors leave through the edge into the neighbor scene, at the same height.

Setting.FloorTextureHint: Seamless tiling image for floors. Empty = drawn by the module.
Setting.RockTextureHint: Seamless tiling image for rock/walls. Empty = drawn by the module.
